summary: Assess utility finances, NRW, and investment readiness through practical diagnostics and planning. Explore the course and request details.
lede: Water utility creditworthiness training helps utility leaders and finance, commercial, and non-revenue-water teams assess investment readiness. Participants build utility diagnostics, interpret IWA water-balance and non-revenue-water indicators, and examine revenue, costs, cash flow, and debt-service capacity. They also develop an improvement plan and draft a performance-based contracting outline, connecting operational priorities with financial decisions and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect water service delivery with utility finance, institutional performance, and investment readiness.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water utility operations, finance, commercial services, or public-service delivery is recommended. No programming is required; basic spreadsheet use will support the practical financial and performance exercises.
